exposure: nutritional status (assessed by food frequency questionnaire)
cohort: 125 pregnant women (62 with preeclampsia and 63 normal pregnant) referred to the obstetrics and gynecology department of Imam-Ali Hospital, Zahedan, Iran
finding: Pregnant women with preeclampsia had higher pre-pregnancy body mass index, cesarean delivery rates, and a higher likelihood of delivering low birth weight babies, and there was an association between grain intake and preeclampsia risk.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with preeclampsia had higher rates of cesarean delivery.
